judgment_calls.decision: "Thirst, dry mouth, poor skin turgor, BP < 90/60, dehydration likely" read as any one of the signs (or).
judgment_calls.alternatives: All four (and); at least two (any2). The heart-failure item uses an explicit "and"; this one does not.

judgment_calls.decision: Sudden onset + Asymmetry on face/arm/leg weakness and numbness; Sudden onset only on speech and visual disturbance; "New" taken as implied.
